definitions.code: const fields=["label","ref","sha","repo","user"],aliases={"label":"label","ref":"ref","sha":"sha","repo":"repo","user":"user"},nullable=["repo","user"],remainder=inputs.remainder??{};for(const key of Object.keys(remainder))if(fields.includes(key)&&!(nullable.includes(key)&&remainder[key]===null&&!Object.hasOwn(inputs,aliases[key])))throw Error('Remainder collides with a declared field');const entries=Object.entries(remainder);for(const key of fields)if(Object.hasOwn(inputs,aliases[key]))entries.push([key,inputs[aliases[key]]]);return {value:Object.fromEntries(entries)};
definitions.documentation:
Assemble Gitea Git Reference from typed fields.

Pure transformation, no provider calls, credentials or persistent state. The pinned input/output contracts validate every value. Missing optional fields stay absent; falsy values and explicit schema-supported nulls are retained. Object remainder fields cannot collide with declared fields; unknown extension values remain an explicit JSON dictionary. List decoding removes the selected item at index (default zero), returns rest, index and original count; empty lists omit item. Encoding reinserts an optional item at index. Invalid indices fail.

Gitea Git Reference. Known documented fields are structural. Unknown provider extensions remain finite JSON. Optional absent values stay absent; nullable structured fields use a retained null remainder when their nonnull socket cannot carry null. Source: https://docs.gitea.com/api/1.24/
